```sql:start-line-number:7:min-lines:20:max-lines:3 CREATE TABLE staff ( PRIMARY KEY (staff_num), staff_num INT(5) NOT NULL, first_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, last_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, hire_date DATE NOT NULL, salary DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL ); SELECT s.staff_num, s.first_name, s.last_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM staff AS s JOIN orders AS o ON o.staff_num = s.staff_num WHERE s.hire_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.salary > 50000 GROUP BY s.staff_num, s.first_name, s.last_name HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) > 10 ORDER BY s.last_name ASC; ```
